The primary subject is a vertical traffic signal head showing red, amber, and green lights simultaneously (or in rapid succession/long exposure effect). It is mounted on a cantilevered black metal arm attached to a vertical pole. There are secondary street light fixtures and tree silhouettes in the background.

Its edges blend into the sky, and its structural connection to the pole is ambiguous or missing, suggesting AI generation failure in rendering complex background details.

The connection between the horizontal mast arm and the vertical pole lacks clear mechanical detail (bolts, brackets). The arm seems to merge slightly into the pole rather than attaching via a distinct bracket, though this could be due to low resolution/silhouette.
The sky exhibits a uniform, noisy texture lacking natural cloud variation or gradient smoothness, typical of AI-generated backgrounds in low-light conditions.
